quotes.text: Learn how to add custom payment methods to Elements.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Only render trusted content within the `container` that’s provided by `handleEmbed`.
While you handle custom payment method transactions outside of Stripe

findings: November raw/stripe-payments-payment-element-custom-payment-methods-2026-11-07.md:5-14 rephrases Payment Element as Elements and replaces the inline April 21 material with Checkout Sessions embedded-components and Payment Intents Elements links. April already had both routes, including a Checkout Sessions merchant-instructed payment statement and a detailed Payment Intents branch (raw/stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods-2025.md:4-25). The index confirms route existence, not contents or feature launch. Diff tracking/collections/stripe/recollection-2026-11-07-en/pages/117b583cbdda6a24d5d9e266/content.diff:229 combines the old final fence and first new index line at the file boundary.

April's detailed variant requires a Stripe account and a completed deferred payments integration, creates name/logo and cpmt_ type ID in Dashboard, configures client customPaymentMethods and shows static or Preview embedded options. Client elements.submit returns selectedPaymentMethod and routes by cpmt_ to the merchant server or external page. The PSP handles processing and finalization, and merchant owns PSP agreement/law compliance. Default CPM ordering last is adjustable via paymentMethodOrder. See raw/stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods-2025.md:18-58,140-174. Keep this scoped to the detailed Payment Intents variant, with no result or settlement inferred from rendering, selection or external redirect.

Embedded Preview content runs in the provided DOM container. The April callback list and samples use handleRender and handleDestroy, while the trusted-content warning says handleEmbed (raw/stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods-2025.md:61-96,118-124). Preserve the warning, and identify the name discrepancy so it cannot be copied as a hook. Tag-specific declarations summarized by wiki/sources/stripe/github/source-github-stripe-js.md:274-281 corroborate handleRender and optional handleDestroy for that later typed contract, without proving hosted access or universal lifecycle details.

April optional recording creates a Stripe PaymentMethod instance with type custom and custom.type set to the cpmt_ type ID. reportPayment references its pm_ ID and separately includes external processor payment reference and actual outcome/timing. Its successful example uses outcome guaranteed after processMyCustomPayment. A Payment Record reports an outside result and does not process or guarantee it. See raw/stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods-2025.md:175-225 and wiki/sources/source-stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods.md:78-94. The source generalizes the example's 2026-03-25.dahlia; invoice_partial_payments_beta=v3 into a requirement. Date it as an example. The separate Report API reference raw/stripe-api-payment-record-report-2026-11-07.md:5-24,78-136 uses a 2026-10-28.endive example with inline payment method details, allows initial or terminal reporting, and lists outcomes separately. That scope does not certify current merchant access or the identical old pm_ based example on Endive.

The source wiki/sources/source-stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods.md:13,106 excludes Checkout Sessions from full integration without capture qualification. April's Checkout Sessions subsection was brief, and it explicitly names merchant-instructed payments with Payment Element (raw/stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods-2025.md:8-12). The separate May 8 product overview matrix lists Checkout unsupported (raw/stripe-custom-payment-methods-2025.md:68-76), whereas November's corresponding matrix lists Checkout supported and Express Checkout Element private preview (raw/stripe-payments-payment-methods-custom-payment-methods-2026-11-07.md:57-75). wiki/sources/source-stripe-custom-payment-methods.md:22-34 and wiki/concepts/stripe-custom-payment-methods.md:21-33 retain the old Checkout cell. Date and cross-link the three distinct evidence scopes, without treating the new index as proof of parity, support for a particular Checkout UI or account, or change to the April Payment Intents callback/record path.

Source wiki/sources/source-stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods.md:66-94 is illustrative, not a complete executable handler. Client POST at raw/stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods-2025.md:148-155 and server GET at raw/stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods-2025.md:186-187 differ. The raw sample also abbreviates validation and the external payment result. Mark that illustrative mismatch and preserve the need to handle submit errors and use the actual external result before reporting guaranteed. Do not describe selection or successful record creation as external payment completion.

source_assessments.reason: Correct unsupported cross-API exclusivity and mandatory beta/version language, identify illustrative callback and request mismatches, and preserve external outcome and reporting boundaries independently of the navigation-only raw delta.

answers.Q1: The November 7 snapshot of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-element/custom-payment-methods explains that custom payment methods can be added to Elements and links separate Checkout Sessions and Payment Intents variants (new raw lines 5-14). April already named both routes and gave a concise Checkout Sessions merchant-instructed payment note. Its detailed Payment Intents route called for a Stripe account and deferred integration, followed by a Dashboard-created cpmt_ type, client static or embedded Preview configuration and selection through elements.submit (old raw lines 8-58, 61-96 and 140-174). The merchant processes and finalizes payment outside Stripe under its PSP and legal obligations. It can then optionally create a Stripe custom PaymentMethod instance identified separately from the cpmt_ type and report the actual processor reference and outcome as a Payment Record (old raw lines 175-225). The existing source-stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods.md preserves much of that route but overgeneralizes Checkout exclusion and the April recording sample's API version. Display, selected method, external processing and optional Stripe recording are separate states.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-element/custom-payment-methods, new raw lines 5-14 change the wording to Elements and replace the April detailed bodies with variant navigation. Keep the April 21 prerequisites, Preview and trusted-content warning, handleRender and handleDestroy examples, default ordering, separate PSP and Payment Record roles, and the example-level Dahlia beta header dated (old raw lines 18-41, 61-96, 140-174 and 175-225). In source-stripe-payment-element-custom-payment-methods.md qualify the Payment Intents-only and mandatory beta statements. Cross-link separate overview evidence. Its May matrix calls Checkout unsupported, while its November matrix lists Checkout supported and Express Checkout private preview. April's own short Checkout Sessions statement names merchant-instructed payments (old raw lines 8-18). These sources do not define parity across Checkout surfaces or account access. The separate Report API capture has an Endive example with inline custom details and describes initial or terminal reporting, so retain the dated April version and instance-ID example without universalizing them. Preserve the April handleEmbed naming inconsistency and client POST/server GET sample mismatch. A callback, selected method or reported guaranteed outcome does not establish that Stripe processed or settled an external payment.
